title: Caraway Deli Rye Loaf
summary: A bread and rye flour dough with caraway and molasses, baked in a tin until the centre reaches 96 °C.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
vegetable oil, plus extra for the tin

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Mix the flours, yeast, caraway and salt, add the molasses, oil and water and knead 8-10 min; the dough will stay slightly tacky.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 1-1½ h until about doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Oil the tin, press the dough into a rectangle, roll up tightly and set seam-down in the tin.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover and leave 45-60 min until it rises about 2 cm above the rim. Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 40-45 min until dark golden and the centre reads 96 °C.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Turn out and cool completely on the rack before slicing.

tips: Rye dough stays sticky; resist adding much flour.
Check the inside temperature to be sure it is baked.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature for up to 3 days, or slice and freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
